item.title: Artificial Intelligence in Financial Decision Making
item.content:encoded:
This special issue focuses on the integration of artificial intelligence technologies into financial decision-making processes. The call seeks research that explores how machine learning, deep learning, and other AI techniques are being applied to enhance financial analysis, trading strategies, and risk management.

Appel publié par Finance research letters. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • AI applications in finance
  • Machine learning for investment decisions
  • Algorithmic trading
  • Credit risk assessment
  • Fraud detection
  • Portfolio optimization
  • Natural language processing in finance
  • Deep learning models
  • Financial forecasting
  • Automated financial advisory

Timeline

  • February 28, 2027: Submission deadline
